tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid tool on this server with its price in USDC and what it returns. Health research evidence from PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA safety signals (adverse event reports, recalls) and official NIH supplement fact sheets. Not medical advice.

tools.name: health_claim_report
tools.description: All-in-one health claim check for AI agents. Send a topic (e.g. ashwagandha) and optional outcome (e.g. anxiety) and get the research evidence from PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov (study counts by type, research-volume level, key studies) plus FDA safety signals (adverse event reports, reactions, reca

tools.name: health_evidence_check
tools.description: Pay-per-call health evidence check for AI agents. Send a topic (e.g. green tea) and optional outcome (e.g. blood pressure) and get counts of PubMed studies by type (human, randomised trials, systematic reviews, animal-only), registered clinical trials, a research-volume level and links to key review

tools.name: nih_supplement_factsheet
tools.description: Pay-per-call official NIH fact sheet for AI agents. Send a vitamin, mineral, supplement or health topic (e.g. vitamin D, magnesium, omega-3, insomnia) and get plain-English sections on what it is, what the science says, possible harms and interactions, with a link, as JSON. From NIH ODS, with NIH Me

tools.name: supplement_safety_signals
tools.description: Pay-per-call FDA safety signals for AI agents. Send a supplement or food ingredient (e.g. ashwagandha, kratom, green tea extract) and get the number of FDA adverse event reports for products named with it, the most reported reactions and outcomes, and recent recalls with class and reason, as JSON. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: health_evidence_check · Public sink: health_claim_report, health_evidence_check, nih_supplement_factsheet, supplement_safety_signals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: health_evidence_check · Public sink: health_claim_report, health_evidence_check, nih_supplement_factsheet, supplement_safety_signals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
